tickets.title: Coordinate account access recovery
tickets.text: Assist Rowan Cloudpuddle in recovering access to the Velvet Acorn Custody portal after changing mobile carriers to retrieve confirmations and statements needed for distribution authorization.

subTasks.title: Confirm access problem and security boundaries
subTasks.text: Ask Rowan which portal is affected, what error message appears, and confirm no passwords or codes are requested.

subTasks.title: Handoff to custodian or platform recovery channel
subTasks.text: Provide Rowan with the correct Velvet Acorn Custodian recovery path and support contact method.

subTasks.title: Verify restoration and update records
subTasks.text: Verify access is restored and update internal records.

tickets.title: Collect care cost evidence for distribution planning
tickets.text: Collect care cost evidence for Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton's distribution planning, including assisted living rate sheets, admission deposit info, and Silver Marmot Insurance claim requirements.

tickets.title: Follow up on client tax notice
tickets.text: Coordinate with Talia Bramblequill of Clockwork Clover Tax to review withholding and estimated taxes for Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton, considering the recent $18,500 IRA distribution, the proposed $50,000 withdrawal, and the increased monthly distribution.
tickets.evidence: Rowan authorized coordination with Talia Bramblequill on a withholding and estimated tax check, and the agreed follow-up has a date of 2026-02-25.

tickets.title: Compare funding sources for roof deposit
tickets.text: Compare using taxable money market funds, IRA cash, or the home equity line to fund the $26,000 roof deposit for Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton without reducing emergency reserves below the nine-month target.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to compare using taxable money market funds, IRA cash, or the home equity line so the deposit can be funded without unintentionally reducing emergency reserves below Rowan’s stated minimum, with a date of 2026-02-16.

tickets.title: Update retirement income projection
tickets.text: Update the retirement income projection for Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton using lower earned income (Elena's reduced capacity) and higher care expenses (in-home assistance).
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to update the retirement income projection using lower earned income and higher care expenses, with a date of 2026-03-04.

tickets.title: Assess HELOC payoff, refinance, or hold strategy
tickets.text: Assess whether paying down the $38,000 Pocket Lantern Bank home equity line, refinancing, or leaving it in place is best for Rowan Cloudpuddle and Elena Mossbutton, considering the 8.1% variable rate versus the 3.25% mortgage and cash reserve targets.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to assess whether paying down the line, refinancing, or leaving it in place is most consistent with the cash reserve target and retirement income plan, with a date of 2026-03-11.
